description: Move, rotate, and resize placed objects with the controllers: point to highlight, GRIP to grab (free objects move/rotate in full 3D; surface-attached objects slide on their surface), GRIP a corner handle to resize. Owner-only; changes commit when you release.

reelSpeed.desc: metres/sec the thumbstick reels a grabbed object in/out

rotateSpeed.desc: degrees/sec a held model turns at full stick deflection
